description: Bounded internal procedures, exact original quick_sort, activation semantics, and safety boundaries.

cases.name: original_quick_sort
cases.expected_stdout:
0 T T T T 0 0
1 T T T T -4 1
2 T T T T 0 3
6 T T T T 11 21
7 T T T T 22 28
8 T T T T 40 36
17 T T T T 0 153
31 T T T T 0 496
64 T T T T 6 2080
64 T T T T 6 2080
cases.note: Entire original quick_sort including both internal routines is byte-identical with CRLF. Wrapper only defines real64 dp and elemental isnan generic. Tests sizes 0,1,2,6,7,8,17,31,64, duplicates, sorted/reverse, full permutation and value/index association, repeated calls.

cases.name: local_shadowing
cases.note: second sees host x, never calling sibling first local x.

cases.name: recursive_host_activation
cases.note: An internal child calls a recursive host and then must return to its original host activation. Sibling calls use that activation.

cases.name: expression_snapshot
cases.note: Parenthesized actual is a value snapshot; child may write host x without dummy storage alias.

cases.name: host_actual_not_captured
cases.note: Passing a host local to a child is safe if the child does not otherwise access its host storage.

cases.name: host_saved_state
cases.note: Existing SAVE semantics must not turn captured saved storage into per-activation copies.

cases.name: internal_depth_limit
cases.note: Deliberately infinite recursion: compile-only GNU and bounded interpreter failure, never execute GNU.

cases.name: alias_direct
cases.diagnostic: also referenced through callee host/USE association
cases.note: GNU compile only. Direct/transitive host access aliases a dummy actual; conservative interpreter boundary, including harmless read-only alias.

cases.name: alias_transitive
cases.diagnostic: also referenced through callee host/USE association
cases.note: GNU compile only. Direct/transitive host access aliases a dummy actual; conservative interpreter boundary, including harmless read-only alias.

cases.name: alias_readonly_conservative
cases.diagnostic: also referenced through callee host/USE association
cases.note: GNU compile only. Direct/transitive host access aliases a dummy actual; conservative interpreter boundary, including harmless read-only alias.

cases.name: alias_array_element
cases.diagnostic: also referenced through callee host/USE association
cases.note: Conservative whole-storage overlap for array element actual and host array reference; compile-only.

cases.name: ordinary_function_host_write
cases.note: Standard-valid GNU; interpreter ordinary-function external-side-effect boundary.

cases.name: ordinary_function_transitive_host_write
cases.note: Transitive side effect through sibling must be rejected before evaluation.

cases.name: nested_contains
cases.note: Fortran internal subprogram may not itself contain an internal subprogram.

cases.name: internal_wrong_host
cases.note: GNU rejects at link (unresolved external); internal child is not visible in sibling host.

cases.name: main_internal
cases.note: Initial bounded subset only supports internal procedures within module procedures.

cases.name: external_internal
cases.note: Initial bounded subset only supports module hosts.

cases.name: internal_procedure_argument
cases.note: No escaping internal procedures, procedure dummy arguments or closure support in this feature.

cases.name: host_active_do_write
cases.note: Invalid modification of an active host DO variable; never execute GNU. Runtime must protect aliased host binding.

cases.name: host_active_do_writable_actual
cases.note: Indirect active-DO write through writable dummy; compile-only GNU.

cases.name: host_active_do_nested_loop
cases.note: Nested internal loop reuses an active host DO variable; never execute GNU.

cases.name: capture_optional_specification
cases.note: Unsupported optional capture occurs only in a child specification expression, not its body.

cases.name: internal_shadows_module_procedure
cases.note: The internal procedure hides the same-named module procedure only within its host.

cases.name: capture_host_function_result
cases.note: Standard-valid result-variable host association is excluded from the bounded interpreter subset.

cases.name: elemental_host_contains
cases.note: GNU accepts this standard-valid ELEMENTAL host with a pure internal function; the bounded interpreter subset excludes ELEMENTAL hosts.

cases.name: impure_elemental_child_host_counter
cases.note: Existing IMPURE ELEMENTAL effect policy applies to internal child functions. Captured host counter changes once per array element.

cases.name: simple_mutable_capture
cases.note: SIMPLE forbids reading mutable host storage, including an otherwise read-only capture. GNU is explicitly skipped; no native SIMPLE conformance or PURE-lowered semantics are claimed.
cases.gnu_skip_reason: SIMPLE is not evaluated under this suite's GNU Fortran 2018 mode

cases.name: simple_parameter_capture
cases.note: SIMPLE may reference a host named constant. GNU is explicitly skipped; no native SIMPLE conformance or PURE lowering is claimed.
cases.gnu_skip_reason: SIMPLE is not evaluated under this suite's GNU Fortran 2018 mode

cases.name: host_bound_composition
cases.note: The same captured host INTEGER INTENT(IN) dummy n supplies an internal explicit-shape dummy bound and local CHARACTER length. Exercises lengths three, one, and zero. No host-local or host-array-inquiry bound claim.
